absent: the rest of the shot's catalog window; ramp-up uncertain where the rule fires in it; stretches the record did not cover not observable
crowd: span rows iscrowd 1 (the whole interval), onset point rows iscrowd 0; t_start == t_end marks a point

locked.rule: labeler.tearing.rule.frequency_locks / apply_locking: the mode's frequency falls to <= 1 kHz for 20 ms after >= 1.5 kHz, within the interval's last 150 ms or 100 ms after it; set only when true

m.rule: labeler.tearing.surface.supported_m: m is recorded (with efit_tree efit01) only when the interval's median q profile inside rho 0.95 has exactly one rational surface m / n with m > n; otherwise m is left empty (no radial evidence, ECE or the poloidal array, is used)
m.signal: qpsi_EFIT01 (the shot's feature file), offline EFIT01

plasma_start: labeler.events.spans.plasma_start: the rule runs from the time Ip reaches its flat-top fraction; each shot's start is in $LABELER_ROOT/round4/tm/labels/plasma_start_<set>.json
